title: EFC -- v2.2 Cross-Field Integration Summary
abstract: Cross-field integration summary for EFC v2.2. Describes how thermodynamic, structural, dynamical, entropic, and informational components integrate into a unified cross-field architecture. Focuses on coupling mechanisms, interfaces, and multi-level mapping linking Grid, Entropy, Energy Flow, and Information fields.

efc_context.regime_relevance: All regimes -- focuses on inter-field coupling across L0-L3

key_results: Defines coupling tensors between all four EFC fields
Maps multi-level integration from Grid (micro) to Cosmological (macro)
Establishes interface contracts for thermodynamic-structural coupling
Introduces coupling strength parameters for each field pair
Demonstrates consistency of cross-field architecture with v2.1 modules
